entities.name: Aspartate aminotransferase
observations: The 407-residue query is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Oryza sativa cytoplasmic aspartate aminotransferase P37833.
The protein belongs to the Aminotran_1_2 family (PF00155), positions 33–399, consistent with a class-I PLP-dependent aminotransferase.
Reference annotations assign EC 2.6.1.1, homodimeric organization, cytoplasmic localization, and pyridoxal 5'-phosphate dependence.

entities.name: Aspartate transamination
observations: This is a PLP-dependent transfer of the amino group from aspartate to 2-oxoglutarate, linking aspartate and glutamate metabolism.

entities.name: Pyridoxal 5'-phosphate
observations: Annotated cofactor for the query-matching aspartate aminotransferase.
